#### 1. neuroferritinopathy  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.783)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:3999)

**Proposed mechanism:** FTL (HGNC:3999) —DISRUPTS→ Ferritin complex assembly and iron storage (GO:0006017); Ferritin complex assembly and iron storage (GO:0006017) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodegeneration (HP:0002092); Ferritin complex assembly and iron storage (GO:0006017) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal involuntary movements (HP:0002332). **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of FTL in iron homeostasis and protein aggregation could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting iron chelation or protein stabilization applicable to both MONDO:0014274 and neuroferritinopathy.
